title: Sector Nine Rising Again
author: Ivo Nystrom
blurb: Ada Blackwood, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
